messages:
Maya Patel: Quick QA pass on the localization coverage matrix + endpoint links — I noticed two problems: Brazil (pt-BR) is listed under 'EU' endpoints and New Zealand examples still reference 'ap-southeast-1'. Can someone confirm the intended endpoints for those locales?

Sam Nguyen: oof, thanks for the catch. I think Brazil should be sa-east-1 (not EU). NZ should be ap-southeast-2. Where did you see the EU mapping?

Maya Patel: In the table on /docs/platform/regions.md (bottom section) and in the JS SDK snippet in the localization guide. Snip: 
```js
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'eu-west-1' }); // example in guide for pt-BR
```

Liam Chen: I put that example in originally as a placeholder, my bad — copy/paste brain. I'll push a small PR to update the snippet and the table. Assigning to myself.

Ola García: @Liam please also double-check the data residency note text for Brazil — legal asked to be explicit that pt-BR customers can choose EU residency if they have contracts in place. We should not imply default residency.

Liam Chen: noted. I'll add a parenthetical and link to the residency FAQ. Draft PR link coming in a sec.

Ashley (docs-bot): PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478 — updates regions table, JS/py SDK snippets, and adds residency clarification for pt-BR. CI: docs build queued.

Sam Nguyen: Thanks! Quick check on the SDK snippet for Python too — sample currently uses the endpoint constant from the hosted API docs but doesn't show regional override. Suggest adding a small example: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(region='sa-east-1')  # pt-BR
print(client.generate('hi'))
```

Maya Patel: That looks good. Also, the links in the table point to old anchor names. Two broken anchors: #eu-residency-details and #apac-howto. Need redirects or anchor fixes.

Liam Chen: I'll update anchors in the regions.md and add redirects in the TOC include. Will ping infra if deploy needs a manual step.

Ashley (docs-bot): Docs build passed for PR 478. Preview: https://deploy-preview-478--docs.redwood.ai/platform/regions.html

Maya Patel: Preview looks good. One tiny nit: the NZ example still shows 'ap-southeast-1' in the CLI snippet.

Liam Chen: fixing now, committing.

deploy-bot: staging deploy triggered for updated docs (preview still live).

Sam Nguyen: After merge can someone do a quick smoke test against the SDK snippet in the snippets repo? I can run the python/JS examples locally.

Ola García: I'll run legal QA on the residency wording once PR is merged. If it's just clarifying language, should be fast.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — once merged I'll add a short release note in the changelog (docs section) so support can reference the corrected endpoints. :tada:
